_PROVENANCE.purpose: Honest per-parameter WQ retrieval on the SAME 4 bands + station holdout used by the shipped HydroDenseNet (SENTINEL-Lite). Reports imagery-ONLY (the paper's 'no in-situ sensors' claim) vs imagery+in-situ-pH-strip (what train_hydrodensenet.py actually feeds the net via FiLM). Marks which parameters are optically recoverable vs physics-limited.
_PROVENANCE.data: data/processed/satellite/drone_wq_pairs.npz (REAL Sentinel-2 L2A B02,B03,B04,B08 paired with same-day USGS/NWIS in-situ WQ).
_PROVENANCE.target_zscore_leakage: NONE — GBM predicts raw/log targets; R2 on pooled out-of-fold predictions. No global target-mean/std bleed.
_PROVENANCE.split: STATION (site_id) GroupKFold — no site shared train/test.
_PROVENANCE.chl_a: No chl-a target exists in this dataset (targets = DO,pH,Turb,Temp,SpCond).

shipped_v4_with_insitu_pH.note: waterdronenet_v4_holdout.json — these numbers USE an in-situ pH-strip input via FiLM, so they are NOT imagery-only despite the paper's claim.

DO.physical_note: Dissolved O2 has no color; only weakly optical via algae/turbidity proxies.

pH.physical_note: pH is only weakly optical; here it is primarily used as an INPUT feature.

Turb.physical_note: Turbidity/TSS IS optical (red/NIR backscatter) but heavy-tailed -> log space.

log.note: log-space R2 is the honest recoverability metric for this heavy-tailed target; raw-unit R2 is distorted by rare extreme values.

Temp.physical_note: Water temperature has a genuine optical/seasonal signature; recoverable.

SpCond.physical_note: Specific conductance = dissolved-ion conductance; NOT an optical property. Physics-limited from reflectance alone.

DO.interpretation: Adding the in-situ pH strip changes DO R2 by +0.066 (CI[+0.042,+0.090]). If this is large & CI excludes 0, the shipped v4 DO number is pH-driven, not imagery-only.

Turb.interpretation: Adding the in-situ pH strip changes Turb R2 by +0.001 (CI[-0.011,+0.013]). If this is large & CI excludes 0, the shipped v4 Turb number is pH-driven, not imagery-only.

Temp.interpretation: Adding the in-situ pH strip changes Temp R2 by +0.009 (CI[+0.005,+0.013]). If this is large & CI excludes 0, the shipped v4 Temp number is pH-driven, not imagery-only.

SpCond.interpretation: Adding the in-situ pH strip changes SpCond R2 by -0.002 (CI[-0.023,+0.015]). If this is large & CI excludes 0, the shipped v4 SpCond number is pH-driven, not imagery-only.

verdict.SpCond: Imagery-only SpCond R2=0.505 (raw). Adding the in-situ pH strip moves it to 0.504 (delta -0.002, CI[-0.0228, 0.0146]). Dissolved-ion conductance is NOT optical; the shipped v4 SpCond R2=0.44 is driven by the pH input, not imagery. In log space, imagery-only SpCond log-R2=0.498.
verdict.DO: Imagery-only DO R2=0.519; +pH strip -> 0.586 (delta +0.066, CI[0.0416, 0.09]). DO is weakly optical (algae/turbidity proxies); the pH input adds +0.066.
verdict.Temp: Imagery-only Temp R2=0.737 CI[0.7169, 0.7548]. Genuinely optical (seasonal/thermal-optical signal); the strongest honest imagery-only parameter.
verdict.Turb: Imagery-only Turb: raw R2=0.012 (heavy-tailed artifact), LOG-R2=0.263 CI[0.2137, 0.3079]. Turbidity IS optical but only recoverable in log space; raw-NTU R2 is a metric artifact of extreme values.

headline: HydroDenseNet is NOT imagery-only: it feeds an in-situ pH strip via FiLM. Honest imagery-only recoverability: Temp strong, Turb (log) moderate, DO weak, SpCond physics-limited (~0, not 0.44). The SpCond/DO gains in v4 come from the in-situ pH input.
